row.notes: (lib) Robin-hood hash probe keyed by a user id variant (type byte at +0, type 7 uses +0x18^+0x20, others +8^+0x10, type 3 with +0x38 set hashes to -1). Uses multiplier +0x20, key pointers +0x28, info bytes +0x30, mask +0x40, info increment +0x50 and shift +0x54; equality falls back to Ne_UserId_Equals. Returns the slot index, or the end index (count of slots) when not found.
